verdict.rationale: Cursor documents a headless CLI print mode (`-p`, `--force`) keyed by `CURSOR_API_KEY`, machine-readable json/stream-json output with non-zero exit codes on failure, and a first-class GitHub Actions recipe. Service accounts are recommended for CI/cron use, and a Cloud Agents API and SDK support programmatic automation; the live API host is probe-verified. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that headless/CI runs work reliably in practice.
